author: ylecun
text:
Terry Tao is probably the most measured, pro-AI mathematician on the planet - which makes this quote especially concerning to read. 😟

If sharing your hunches means getting scooped ~immediately without acknowledgement, then we're going to see not just math but all other science / engineering disciplines go dark.
